topic: UGC NET Dec 2026 fee: last day today
hook: UGC NET Dec 2026: form filled but fee unpaid? Pay by *tonight*
hook_b: Filled the UGC NET form last week? It's *not* done till you pay
tldr: NTA has extended the UGC NET December 2026 fee payment window till tonight (Nov 1) for candidates who submitted the form but did not pay.

beats.what: NTA extended the UGC NET December 2026 fee payment deadline to November 1.
beats.why: The application deadline was already pushed from Oct 28 to Oct 31; this gives unpaid applicants one more day.
beats.care: Applied but didn't pay? Your form isn't complete. Pay on ugcnet.nta.nic.in tonight.

effects.label: Pay tonight or lose the attempt

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: 🎓 Deadline. NTA has given UGC NET December 2026 applicants who submitted the form but didn't pay the fee one more day: the payment window is open till tonight, Nov 1. The application deadline itself was already extended from Oct 28 to Oct 31. The exam is scheduled to start Dec 14. Do it on the official site ugcnet.nta.nic.in, not via agents. Exact closing time and correction-window dates: check the NTA notice on the site; we couldn't confirm them.

cards.q: Why do people miss exam fee deadlines?
When is the UGC NET Dec 2026 fee deadline?
cards.why: NTA extended the fee payment window to Nov 1 for those who filled the form but didn't pay.

viz.l: last chance to pay the UGC NET fee

insight: Filling the form isn't enough: an unpaid application usually doesn't count.
watch: Correction window and city-slip dates on ugcnet.nta.nic.in.
